decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the three Prince William County 'Data Center Campuses' polygons for rezoning cases REZ2022-00032 (Digital Gateway North), REZ2022-00033 (Digital Gateway South) and REZ2022-00036 (Compass Datacenters Prince William County Campus 1) along Pageland Lane as the campus locator replacing the imported Gainesville locality point.
layer: Prince William County GIS 'CountyMapper/LandDevelopment' MapServer layer 11 'Data Center Campuses' (gisweb.pwcva.gov), queried for the three case numbers and requested in WGS84 (outSR 4326)

facts.centroid_method: shapely planar centroid of the union in WGS84 longitude/latitude; the EPSG:32618 planar centroid transformed back differs by 0.18 m
facts.case_status_cross_check: The same service's planning-case layer 2 lists all three cases as 'Suspended (On-Hold)' and states that, per the Virginia Court of Appeals order dated 29 July 2026, the Board of County Supervisors' approval of each rezoning is void. The locator describes the land of the proposal; no status is taken from it.
facts.area_cross_check: union 1,759.94 geodesic acres; case descriptions ±534, ±342 and ±884 acres; the Atlas note describes a roughly 2,000-acre corridor of three adjoining rezoning areas

exclusions: Other data-centre campus polygons in the layer are not part of the union. Planner names, e-mail addresses and telephone numbers carried by the planning-case layer are not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport or locality centre is used.
